title: •Rayc Ryjerd
caption: •Rayc Ryjerd (V)
game_text: {pilot:3}. Twice per game, may ▲ one Big One, Kessel Run, or Rycar’s Run. Once per game, may double the value of X for Kessel Run or Rycar’s Run. Rayc is a matching pilot for any freighter or yacht.
lore: An ‘honest’ smuggler. Working for Jabba to pay off debts for his ship. Rycar’s son. Even more of an idiot.

notes: Unique. Yellow pilot-power icon followed by '3.' at the start → {pilot:3} — the wiki stub omits this phrase entirely. Slip prints the ▲ triangle where the stub expands 'take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. Third stat box printed blank. Icon column: pilot. Alien (Jabba's Palace frame, single alien disc). The wiki's default 'Rayc Ryjerd' page carries Glossary 2.0 errata text and its image JP-L-raycryjerd.gif (348 px, 'E' label) is the Errata face ('anything he pilots') — downloaded to src/vs5/ but not used; the printed face is 'Rayc Ryjerd (Original)' (350 px decipher-archive, 'any starship he pilots'), same lore/destiny/set. Lore corrected from scan: curly single quotes around ‘honest’ and curly apostrophe in 'Rycar’s' (wiki straight). Copyright 'TM & © 1998 LUCASFILM LTD.
